bullets: Toxicological reference identity and exact source
Exposure route and averaging basis
Non-cancer and cancer treatment
Applicability and uncertainty

nodes.label: Module 3 - Ecological receptors, exposure, and toxicological references
bullets: Receptor identity and life stage

Toxicity or tissue-residue benchmark
Habitat, waterbody, and site linkage

nodes.label: Module 4 - Sediment properties, direct-exposure methods, and analytical context
bullets: Organic carbon, lipid or protein basis, grain size, redox, pH, and related modifiers
Partitioning or AVS-SEM method where applicable

Analytical feasibility and method limitations

nodes.label: Module 5 - Paired sediment, tissue, and transfer evidence
bullets: Co-located sediment and tissue observations
Species, tissue, normalization basis, and exposure duration
Empirical transfer or alternative method candidate
Provenance, uncertainty, and independent test

notes: Every module passes through the shared evidence gate: source + exact location + units + medium + receptor + applicability + uncertainty + independent review.
